title: Two men arrested after Lostprophets singer Ian Watkins dies in prison attack
summary: A 25-year-old and 43-year-old held on suspicion of murder of musician, 49, who was serving 29 years for child sex offences Two men have been arrested on suspicion of murder after the death in prison of the former Lostprophets singer and convicted child sex offender Ian Watkins. The 48-year-old was serving a 29-year sentence at HMP Wakefield, with a further six years on licence, after admitting a string of sex offences including the attempted rape of a baby.
